Humen Pearl River Bridge attraction highlights

The majestic Humen Bridge spans the Pearl River estuary in the southern suburbs of Dongguan, echoing the Weiyuan Fort, and it can be called a landmark building in Dongguan.
This is the first large-scale suspension bridge independently designed and built by my country.
The main bridge is about 4.6 kilometers long, with a two-way six-lane bridge deck.
The main span of suspension cables is 888 meters long, and is known as the "world's first span".
The bridge not only has a huge span, but also does not use any steel locks, so it is famous for its difficult bridge-building technology.
The Humen Bridge connects Humen and Panyu across the sea, making Dongguan an important transportation hub connecting Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Zhuhai and other places.
Underneath the bridge used to be the ancient battlefield of the Opium War.

Although the sky is now clear and the smoke of gunpowder is no longer there, the bridge's majestic and impressive momentum can vaguely make people imagine that Lin Zexu, Guan Tianpei and others "wears golden armor in a hundred battles in yellow sand, and is indestructible." Loulan will never return" that kind of heroic devotion to death.
